StackType.rationale: PowerStackType.Counter. The sim has no StackType concept; Power.on_stack (powers.py:64-66) adds unconditionally, which is what PowerCmd.ModifyAmount does (PowerCmd.cs:236). Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterCardExhausted.issue: Two divergences. (a) THE DRAW COUNT IS HARD-CODED TO 1. DarkEmbracePower.cs:47 draws `base.Amount`; powers.py:255 is `DrawCmd.draw(self.owner, 1)`. Dormant only because the one ported applier always passes 1 (cards/dark_embrace_card.py:34, including its upgrade, which raises no amount) -- the moment any effect stacks Dark Embrace the sim draws one card where the game draws Amount. Named trigger: a second Dark Embrace play, or any card/relic that stacks it. (b) THE ETHEREAL DEFERRAL IS MISSING -- see the AfterSideTurnEnd entry and the causedByEthereal guard. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

AfterSideTurnEnd.issue: DarkEmbracePower.cs:52-60 is half of a two-phase mechanism the sim has none of: an exhaust caused by the Ethereal keyword increments an internal etherealCount instead of drawing, and this hook then draws `Amount * etherealCount` at the side's end -- deliberately, so the cards arrive AFTER the hand flush rather than being flushed away (the source comment at :18-23 says exactly that). The sim draws immediately for every exhaust (powers.py:251-255), so cards Dark Embrace draws off a turn-end ethereal exhaust are discarded by the flush that follows. LIVE the moment both halves co-occur: the sim's ethereal exhausts happen at turn end (cards/base.py's ethereal handling via combat._process_turn_end_cards, combat.py:352-...) and should_ethereal_trigger exists as a hook (hooks.py:696), while Dark Embrace is a ported card. The sim's on_card_exhausted signature (hooks.py:415-419) has no causedByEthereal argument, so this cannot be fixed inside the power. Same missing parameter that turn_structure's gaps G4/G17 record for Joss Paper; per binding rule 3 the shared mechanism -- the absent causedByEthereal flag -- keeps that `gap` verdict, and what is recorded here is Dark Embrace's own deferral being absent on top of it. Third-file citations, not hashed here.

guards.rationale: `card.Owner.Creature != base.Owner` reduces to a tautology in the sim: there is one player, every Card belongs to it, and this power is only ever applied to the player. Same reading power_cmd's sim-entry note and SurroundedPower's own comment (powers.py:2574-2576) already record.

guards.issue: The parameter does not exist on the sim's hook, so the branch cannot be taken. Carried as its own guard because it is the root of the AfterSideTurnEnd gap and a fix has to start here.

guards.rationale: powers.py:252-253 refuses to draw unless the owner is a PlayerCombatState. C# reaches `base.Owner.Player` at :47 and would NullReference on a monster owner, so the sim is defensively equivalent; no ported effect puts Dark Embrace on an enemy.
